facts.fact: AICCRA reports that, with the Ministry of Agriculture, the Institut d'Economie Rurale and Mali-Meteo, it extended RIICE satellite rice monitoring to major irrigated and rainfed rice zones and prepared institutional frameworks to operate the tool within national agricultural monitoring systems.
facts.system: RIICE (Remote Sensing-based Information and Insurance for Crops in Emerging Economies)

systems.owner: AfricaRice, IRRI, sarmap with Ministry of Agriculture, IER, Mali-Meteo
